_note: push/651, HIDDEN: Isonade v4's 14 new jutsu (rev 3 spec, engine-tested offline). Names are placeholders. Generated by push/651_isonade_v4.gen.py; do not hand-edit.

data.name: Isonade Barnacle Hide
data.description: Barnacles close over its hide: a shield that soaks your hits.

data.name: Isonade Tide Draws Back
data.description: The water pulls away from the shore: it gathers itself and brands you. Its next hit is a big one.
data.battleDescription: The water pulls away from the shore. Brine burns into %target.

data.name: Isonade Swell Builds
data.description: The water stacks higher and the brand bites deeper. Its next hit is the big one.
data.battleDescription: The sea rears up behind %user. The brand on %target burns deeper.

data.name: Isonade Breaker
data.description: The wave breaks over you. Then it hangs exposed for a round.

data.name: Isonade Harpoon Line
data.description: It spits the old harpoon back through you. Goes through damage reduction and shields.

data.name: Isonade Omen: Black Water
data.description: Everything but the floating crates is marked red. Black water fills the room next turn.
data.battleDescription: The water goes still and black. Only the floating crates stay pale.

data.name: Isonade Black Water Floods
data.description: Black water fills every hex but the crates; then it surfaces to feed.
data.battleDescription: Black water crashes down. %user surfaces to feed.

data.name: Isonade Omen: The Deep
data.description: It sinks under black water behind a heavy shield. Break the shield before its next turn, or the whole room floods.
data.battleDescription: %user sinks out of sight. The whole hold goes black.

data.name: Isonade The Deep Crashes
data.description: The shield held: the black water crashes over the whole room and washes Isonade clean.
data.battleDescription: Black water rises to the ceiling and crashes down on %target.

data.name: Isonade Surfaces
data.description: Its shield broken, it surfaces gasping and exposed.
data.battleDescription: %user surfaces through its broken shell, gasping.

data.name: Isonade Scour
data.description: The undertow tears your buffs away.

data.name: Isonade Shed
data.description: It sheds its outer skin and every debuff with it.
data.battleDescription: %user sheds a skin of rotten barnacles.

data.name: Isonade Drowned Anchor
data.description: It swings the anchor chain it swallowed. Follows a Scour or a Shed.

data.name: Isonade Silt Cloud
data.description: It churns up silt: your damage next round is cut hard, and it takes less.
